Bad Piggies Editor: https://github.com/LambdaEd1th/badpiggies-editor
Revision: 8697da72181ea1c7770c0b356c93d58678911e0a
Upstream editor code and published binaries: AGPL-3.0-or-later.
See BadPiggiesEditor.LICENSE and BadPiggiesEditor-Sources.zip.
The independent bpsim companion adapter observes the pinned editor's canvas host
and imports files through its supported drag-and-drop file path; upstream WASM is unchanged.
Game assets remain the property of Rovio and are NOT licensed under the AGPL.
Vuplex is supplied by the game host and is not redistributed in this Mod.
InteractiveWaterSystem source/assets are NOT included: author licensing is unresolved.
